G600.def: from «575» and «2525»; to reconstitute (in health, home or organization):--restore (again).

G601.def: from «575» and «2572»; to take off the cover, i.e. disclose:--reveal.

G602.def: from «601»; disclosure:--appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation.

G603.et: from a comparative of (575) and a compound of kara (the head) and (1380) (in the sense of watching)
G603.def: from a comparative of «575» and a compound of kara (the head) and «1380» (in the sense of watching); intense anticipation:--earnest expectation.

G606.def: from «575» and «2749»; to be reserved; figuratively, to await:--be appointed, (be) laid up.

G608.def: from «575» and «2808»; to close fully:--shut up.

G609.def: from «575» and «2875»; to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts):--cut off. Compare «2699».

G610.et: from (611) (in its original sense of judging)
G610.def: from «611» (in its original sense of judging); a judicial decision:--sentence.

G611.def: from «575» and krino; to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare «06030») to begin to speak (where an address is expected):--answer.

G613.def: from «575» and «2928»; to conceal away (i.e. fully); figuratively, to keep secret:--hide.

G614.def: from «613»; secret; by implication, treasured:--hid, kept secret.

G615.def: from «575» and kteino (to slay); to kill outright; figuratively, to destroy:--put to death, kill, slay.

G616.def: from «575» and the base of «2949»; to breed forth, i.e. (by transference) to generate (figuratively):--beget, produce.

G617.def: from «575» and «2947»; to roll away:--roll away (back).

G618.def: from «575» and «2983»; to receive (specially, in full, or as a host); also to take aside:--receive, take.

G619.et: from a comparative of (575) and lauo (to enjoy)
G619.def: from a comparative of «575» and lauo (to enjoy); full enjoyment:--enjoy(-ment).

G620.def: from «575» and «3007»; to leave behind (passively, remain); by implication, to forsake:--leave, remain.

G621.def: from «575» and leicho (to "lick"); to lick clean:--lick.

G622.def: from «575» and the base of «3639»; to destroy fully (reflexively, to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively:--destroy, die, lose, mar, perish.

G623.def: active participle of «622»; a destroyer (i.e. Satan):--Apollyon.

G624.et: from the pagan deity Apollon (i.e. the sun, from (622))
G624.def: from the pagan deity Apollon (i.e. the sun; from «622»); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia:--Apollonia.

G625.def: probably from the same as «624»; Apollos, an Israelite:--Apollos.

G626.et: middle voice from a compound of (575) and (3056)
G626.def: middle voice from a compound of «575» and «3056»; to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, i.e. exculpate (self):--answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self.

G627.def: from the same as «626»; a plea ("apology"):--answer (for self), clearing of self, defence.

G628.def: from «575» and «3068»; to wash fully, i.e. (figuratively) have remitted (reflexively):--wash (away).

G629.def: from a compound of «575» and «3083»; (the act) ransom in full, i.e. (figuratively) riddance, or (specially) Christian salvation:--deliverance, redemption.

G630.def: from «575» and «3089»; to free fully, i.e. (literally) relieve, release, dismiss (reflexively, depart), or (figuratively) let die, pardon or (specially) divorce:--(let) depart, dismiss, divorce, forgive, let go, loose, put (send) away, release, set at liberty.

G631.et: middle voice from (575) and masso (to squeeze, knead, smear)
G631.def: middle voice from «575» and masso (to squeeze, knead, smear); to scrape away:--wipe off.

G632.def: from «575» and the base of «3551»; to apportion, i.e. bestow:--give.

G633.def: from «575» and «3538»; to wash off (reflexively, one's own hands symbolically):--wash.

G635.def: from «575» and «4105»; to lead astray (figuratively); passively, to stray (from truth):--err, seduce.

G636.def: from «575» and «4126»; to set sail:--sail away.

G638.def: from «575» and «4155»; to stifle (by drowning or overgrowth):--choke.

G639.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and the base of (4198)
G639.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and the base of «4198»; to have no way out, i.e. be at a loss (mentally):-- (stand in) doubt, be perplexed.

G640.def: from the same as «639»; a (state of) quandary:--perplexity.

G641.def: from «575» and «4496»; to hurl off, i.e. precipitate (oneself):--cast.

G642.def: from «575» and a derivative of «3737»; to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse):--take.

G643.def: from «575» and a derivative of «4632»; to pack up (one's) baggage:--take up... carriages.

G644.et: from a compound of (575) and a derivative of (4639)
G644.def: from a compound of «575» and a derivative of «4639»; a shading off, i.e. obscuration:--shadow.

G645.def: from «575» and «4685»; to drag forth, i.e. (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously):--(with-)draw (away), after we were gotten from.

G646.def: feminine of the same as «647»; defection from truth (properly, the state) ("apostasy"):--falling away, forsake.

G647.et: neuter of a (presumed) adj. from a derivative of (868)
G647.def: neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of «868»; properly, something separative, i.e. (specially) divorce:--(writing of) divorcement.

G648.def: from «575» and a derivative of «4721»; to unroof:--uncover.

G649.def: from «575» and «4724»; set apart, i.e. (by implication) to send out (properly, on a mission) literally or figuratively:--put in, send (away, forth, out), set (at liberty).

G650.def: from «575» and stereo (to deprive); to despoil:--defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud.

G652.def: from «649»; a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers):--apostle, messenger, he that is sent.

G653.def: from «575» and a (presumed) derivative of «4750»; to speak off-hand (properly, dictate), i.e. to catechize (in an invidious manner):--provoke to speak.

G654.def: from «575» and «4762»; to turn away or back (literally or figuratively):--bring again, pervert, turn away (from).

G655.def: from «575» and the base of «4767»; to detest utterly:--abhor.

G656.def: from «575» and «4864»; excommunicated:--(put) out of the synagogue(-s).

G657.def: middle voice from «575» and «5021»; literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce:--bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away.

G658.def: from «575» and «5055»; to complete entirely, i.e. consummate:--finish.

G659.def: from «575» and «5087»; to put away (literally or figuratively):--cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off).

G660.def: from «575» and tinasso (to jostle); to brush off:--shake off.

G661.def: from «575» and «5099»; to pay in full:--repay.

G662.def: from «575» and «5111»; to venture plainly:--be very bold.

G663.def: from the base of «664»; (figuratively) decisiveness, i.e. rigor:--severity.

G664.et: from a derivative of a comparative of (575) and temno (to cut)
G664.def: adverb from a derivative of a comparative of «575» and temno (to cut); abruptly, i.e. peremptorily:--sharply(-ness).

G665.def: from «575» and the base of «5157»; to deflect, i.e. (reflexively) avoid:--turn away.

G666.def: from the participle of «548»; a being away:--absence.

G667.def: from «575» and «5342»; to bear off (literally or relatively):--bring, carry (away).

G669.def: from «575» and «5350»; to enunciate plainly, i.e. declare:--say, speak forth, utterance.

G670.et: from (575) and the middle voice of (5412)
G670.def: from «575» and the middle voice of «5412»; to unload:--unlade.

G671.def: from a compound of «575» and «5530»; the act of using up, i.e. consumption:--using.

G673.def: from «575» and «5563»; to rend apart; reflexively, to separate:--depart (asunder).

G674.def: from «575» and «5594»; to breathe out, i.e. faint:--hearts failing.

G675.def: of Latin origin; (in the genitive, i.e. possessive case) of Appius, the name of a Roman:--Appii.

G676.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of (4314) and eimi (to go)
G676.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of «4314» and eimi (to go); inaccessible:--which no man can approach.

G677.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (4350)
G677.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «4350»; actively, inoffensive, i.e. not leading into sin; passively, faultless, i.e. not led into sin:--none (void of, without) offence.

G678.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of (4383) and (2983) [cf (4381)]
G678.def: adverb from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of «4383» and «2983» (compare «4381»); in a way not accepting the person, i.e. impartially:--without respect of persons.

G679.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (4417)
G679.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «4417»; not stumbling, i.e. (figuratively) without sin:--from falling.

G680.def: reflexive of «681»; properly, to attach oneself to, i.e. to touch (in many implied relations):--touch.

G681.def: a primary verb; properly, to fasten to, i.e. (specially) to set on fire:--kindle, light.

G682.def: probably of foreign origin; Apphia, a woman of Collosae:--Apphia.

G683.et: from (575) and the middle voice of otheo or otho (to shove)
G683.def: from «575» and the middle voice of otheo or otho (to shove); to push off, figuratively, to reject:--cast away, put away (from), thrust away (from).

G684.def: from a presumed derivative of «622»; ruin or loss (physical, spiritual or eternal):--damnable(-nation), destruction, die, perdition, × perish, pernicious ways, waste.

G685.def: probably from «142»; properly, prayer (as lifted to Heaven), i.e. (by implication) imprecation:--curse.

G686.et: probably from (142) (through the idea of drawing a conclusion)
G686.def: probably from «142» (through the idea of drawing a conclusion); a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows):--haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore. Often used in connection with other particles, especially «1065» or «3767» (after) or «1487» (before). Compare also «687».

G687.pos: 1. a Greek interrogative particle that implies anxiety or impatience on the part of the questioner
G687.et: a form of (686), denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed
G687.def: a form of «686», denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed:--therefore.

G688.def: of Hebrew origin («06152»); Arabia, a region of Asia:--Arabia.

G689.def: of Hebrew origin («07410»); Aram (i.e. Ram), an Israelite:--Aram.

G690.def: from «688»; an Arab or native of Arabia:--Arabian.

G691.def: from «692»; to be idle, i.e. (figuratively) to delay:--linger.

G692.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «2041»; inactive, i.e. unemployed; (by implication) lazy, useless:--barren, idle, slow.

G694.et: neuter of a presumed derivative of (696)
G694.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «696»; silvery, i.e. (by implication) cash; specially, a silverling (i.e. drachma or shekel):--money, (piece of) silver (piece).

G695.def: from «696» and «2875»; a beater (i.e. worker) of silver:--silversmith.

G696.def: from argos (shining); silver (the metal, in the articles or coin):--silver.

G697.et: from Ares (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of (4078)
G697.def: from Ares (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of «4078»; rock of Ares, a place in Athens:--Areopagus, Mars' Hill.

G698.def: from «697»; an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill:--Areopagite.
